name: Helpin Tasks
description: Sidebar panel listing open Helpin tasks; Start opens a workspace on a new branch with an agent working on the task.

settings.title: Helpin MCP URL
settings.description: The https URL of your Helpin server's MCP endpoint. The token is sent only here.

settings.title: Task key prefix
settings.description: Only list tasks whose key starts with this, such as ABC-. Empty lists every open task.

settings.title: Agent to start
settings.description: The agent Orca launches in the new workspace.
